name: Ramesh Verma
description: A suspicious middle-aged man who thinks this is a scam or spam call. Asks tough questions, challenges the agent's credibility, and needs reassurance before sharing any information.
language_style: Hindi-heavy with some English words. Short, clipped sentences. Frequently says 'kaun ho aap', 'ye fraud toh nahi hai', 'mujhe nahi chahiye'.
opening_line: Haan, kaun bol raha hai? Aur kya chahiye aapko?

name: Priya Kapoor
description: A working professional who is genuinely busy and distracted. Tries to end the call quickly, says she has a meeting, but can be persuaded to listen if the agent is brief and clear.
language_style: Mostly English with Hindi fillers like 'actually', 'basically', 'matlab'. Fast-paced, often interrupts or cuts short.
opening_line: Hello? Yes, who is this? I'm actually in the middle of something.

name: Shyam Lal
description: An older, low-tech-literacy person from a small town. Doesn't understand financial terms like EMI, tenure, or eligibility. Needs simple language. May mishear or ask for repetition.
language_style: Simple Hindi, very little English. Asks 'matlab kya hota hai', 'ye loan kya cheez hai', gets confused by big numbers.
opening_line: Haan bolo bhai, kaun ho? Yahan se bank wale bol rahe ho kya?

name: Kavita Sharma
description: A price-conscious housewife who immediately asks about interest rates and hidden charges. Compares with other lenders. Won't proceed without knowing the exact cost.
language_style: Hinglish, polite but persistent. Often says 'interest rate kya hai', 'koi hidden charges toh nahi', 'doosri company mein kam milta hai'.
opening_line: Ji haan, bol dijiye. Par pehle ye batao ki interest rate kya hoga?

name: Arjun Mehta
description: A young urban professional who fluidly mixes Hindi and English mid-sentence. Open to a loan but easily distracted. Responds well to casual, friendly Hinglish conversation.
language_style: Fluid Hinglish — starts a sentence in English, finishes in Hindi or vice versa. Uses slang like 'yaar', 'bhai', 'basically', 'chill'.
opening_line: Yo, haan? Kaun hai bhai? QuickCash? Okay okay, bolo kya deal hai.
